newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to clear Coca-Cola buy of British bottler.
newsitem.headline: EU to clear Coca-Cola buy of British bottler.

text.p: The European Commission is set to clear on Wednesday a plan by Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc to take full control of British bottler Coca-Cola & Schweppes Beverages Ltd (CCSB), European Union sources said.
They said Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert would announce the decision at a news conference.
The move was widely expected after a panel of antitrust experts from the EU's 15 states recommended earlier this month that the proposed acquisition be cleared.

The deal, which will create a bottling and distribution giant, prompted fears that Coca-Cola could dominate the British market for cola. However, Commission competition officials were unable to substantiate such fears.
The outcome is a defeat for Virgin Cola of British tycoon Richard Branson, which filed a complaint with the Commission accusing CCSB of anti-competitive practices in Britain.

Coca-Cola Enterprises, the world's largest Coke bottler, is owned by Coca Cola Co. It is acquiring control of CCSB from Cadbury Schweppes through its purchase of Amalgamated Beverages Great Britain Ltd.
